text_ar: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كُفِّنَ فِي ثَلاَثَةِ أَثْوَابٍ بِيضٍ سَحُولِيَّةٍ ‏.‏
text_ar_search: وحدثني عن مالك، عن يحيى بن سعيد، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم كفن في ثلاثة أثواب بيض سحولية .
text_en:
Yahya related to me from Malik from Hisham ibn Urwa from his
father from A'isha, the wife of the Prophet, may Allah bless him and
grant him peace, that the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and
grant him peace, was shrouded in three pure white cotton garments,
none of which was a long shirt or a turban.
text_id: Telah menceritakan kepadaku Yahya dari Malik dari [Hisyam bin 'Urwah] dari [Bapaknya] dari [Aisyah] isteri Nabi shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam, bahwasanya Rasulullah shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam dikafani dengan tiga lembar kain putih yang terbuat dari katun, tanpa baju dan tanpa penutup kepala."
